## Kind of change

- [ ] Upstream pin update (`config/upstream.lock`)
- [ ] Patch against upstream (`patches/`)
- [ ] Overlay / package list (`overlays/`, `profiles/`)
- [ ] Build tooling, CI or docs

## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/validate.sh` and `tests/run.sh` pass locally
- [ ] Changes against upstream are visible in `build/<profile>/manifest.txt`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or ISO images committed
